tagline: An EDA environment for schematics, PCB layout, verification and simulation. Written so far: model, project file, board, schematic and EAGLE files.
description: EH3D-PHOENIX-PCB is planned as an EDA environment with schematic capture, PCB layout, verification tools, circuit simulation and specialized modules for switch-mode power supplies and RF. Today it holds a workspace with a redacted inventory of a private corpus of design files, the foundations of the design model (checked integer units, object ids, canonical JSON), the project file on the shared container of EH3D-COMMON, the board model with silkscreen and reversible operations, rule checks, the connectivity and rule engine, the schematic with a drawing and reversible editing operations, a reader of EAGLE XML files, a writer and reader of boards as EAGLE XML, readers of KiCad files into the same model, the contract for pairs of EAGLE binary files, the manufacturing export (Gerber X2, Excellon, placement, bill of materials and a manifest of checksums), a viewer and editor prototype (its window has never been seen on a screen), a calculator of board stack-ups and transmission lines (microstrip, stripline, coplanar waveguide, coupled pairs) that can take Dk and Df from the materials database of EH3D-COMMON, a command to browse that database, RF tools (Touchstone files, two-port parameters, matching and ideal ladder filters), a generator of microstrip RF structures drawn from the stack-up and the frequency, an analysis of old EAGLE libraries for duplicates (it never rewrites a library), an editor of EAGLE libraries (operations with undo, checks, footprint generators and saving as a new file), an editor of boards that runs the design rules after every operation (its window never seen on a screen) a set of reference cases with published values and their sources that the calculations are run against (a passing case is not a comparison with another tool) and a command line; all of it has only been tried on generated or hand-made data, and the final editors, the readers of other foreign designs and the reader of the EAGLE binary files are not written.
